healthManager.0x0000: 4 x {u32 entity[256]; u32 count} lists per HealthComponent Size (Size 4 excluded)
healthManager.0x1024: u32 owned count (descriptor flag bit0 set)
healthManager.0x1030: hash buckets {u32 entity, u32 index} x capacity
healthManager.indexStability: indices move: AddInstance/ActivateStaged/RemoveInstance relocate records with MoveRecord; always re-resolve entity -> index through the hash (or verify descriptor+8 == entity)

descriptor.0x14: u32 flags; bit0 = owned by this peer (selects the owned partition; gates network sends in heal paths)

healthRecord.0x04: u8 hit flag: set by ApplyDamage paths, cleared by Update every tick (not reliably pollable)
healthRecord.0x05: u8 enabled (1 on add; ApplyDamage requires != 0)
healthRecord.0x30: u32 owner entity of the last applied hit (resolved event+0x14 GOID)
healthRecord.0x38: u64 creditor peer id of the last applied hit (event+0x18; kept when a hit has none); the kill creditor passed by every health-manager kill dispatch (0x925578, 0x920889, 0x920CF0)
healthRecord.0x40: u32 event+0x60 of the last applied hit (meaning unproven)
healthRecord.0x44: u32 owner entity at downing (initial: invalid id)
healthRecord.0x48: u32 dealer entity at downing (initial: invalid id)
healthRecord.0x19C: u32 life state 0 alive, 1 downed (constitution), 2 dead; SetLifeState only raises it; heals reset <2 to 0
healthRecord.0x1A0: f32 set on init for avatars (meaning unproven)
healthRecord.0x1A4: f32 seconds since last applied damage (Update += dt; ApplyDamage = 0)

healthExt.0x00: u32 damage source kind of the replicated state change (10 = none)
healthExt.0x04: u32 element of the replicated state change
healthExt.0x0C: u32 replicated life state (Update applies it via SetLifeState)
healthExt.0x10: u32 per-source-kind 2-bit acceptance mask: 0 no damage, 1 x1.5, 2 x1.0, 3 x0.75

damageEvent.0x0C: u32 hit actor (converted to a zone actor hash)
damageEvent.0x20: u32 producer argument 4 (hit ring key; meaning unproven)

statMap.0x00: entries (20 bytes: u32 key, u32 value, ...)
statMap.statsIndex: missionStats+0x37D58 hash (cap +0x37D60, empty +0x37D64, mult +0x37D68): player entity -> index
statMap.playerEntity: playerManager: peer ids +0x2C8 (stride 0x38, count +0x84); descriptor +0xE8[i]; entity at +8

hitRing.entry: {u64 dealer entity, u32 key (event+0x20), u32 hits}

vitality.rule: applies only when the target is in the actor (player avatar) manager

unproven: event+0x60 / record+0x40 / record+0x58: copied from hit+0x10 and persisted, but no reader was found that interprets it; it is NOT proven to be the DamageInfoType (the DamageInfoType enters InitHitInfo from its source struct +0x24 and is used only to read the row).
event+0x20 (hit-ring key): producer argument 4; meaning unknown.
Whether record+0x30 (owner) is the avatar, the player entity or another owner for each weapon family; the snapshots contain no damage.
Frame order of HealthManager::Update (0x920260) and the damage drain relative to the Lua update(dt) callback.

Network authority beyond what code shows: heal/revive paths send network messages and update synced health only when descriptor+0x14 bit0 is set; a remote-owned record is overwritten by synced health (0x6B2A90) and ext+0x0C replication.
The data-driven attribute multiplier in producer caller 0x7D01C0 (key = settings row +0xD4, entity = [r12]): which entity is looked up (dealer or target) is not established.
The fraction passed by the stim handler (xmm7 at 0x11C9940) was not traced to its source.
